name: MLBB Post-Game Extractor
desc: Browser-only tool that reads Mobile Legends post-game screenshots with OCR and exports the player stats to CSV, so match data stops being typed in by hand.

p: [Who it was for and what they needed, in two or three sentences.]

Batch OCR runs in Tesseract.js web workers, so a whole set of screenshots is read without leaving the page. A bounding box drawn over one team's column can be mirrored across the center for the other team, and saved as a preset for the next batch.
Before anything is exported, a review step groups the numbers by player and lets hero and role be corrected. The export is either a long file with one row per player or a wide file with 226 columns.
